pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any sword. The exact sword is equipped on release.
Starts waiting; select Fight. Equip a sword, shield, and $(l:care/armor)Slime Armor$(). The bag has normal Capacity. It uses normal melee and shield rules, spending one stamina per successful hit.

Targets has six independent filters. Hostile is enabled initially; Neutral, Passive, Players, Tamed, and Creepers are disabled. Owners, allies, and same-owner companions stay excluded. An Enderman attacking a living companion counts as Hostile until it disengages.
